overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance reveals clear outlier success in domestic and marital relationship dynamics (husband-wife conflicts, shared life realities), achieving up to 1.7k views compared to generic sad poetry which underperformed heavily.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on husband-wife dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') achieved the highest views on the channel (~1,700 views each).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on domestic relationship dynamics, middle-class household compromises, and unspoken marital expectations.

winning_patterns.evidence: Grounded family observations like mothers asking 'Khana khaya?' or fathers hiding exhaustion performed moderately well (150-250 views) compared to abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Keep hooks grounded in specific, highly recognizable micro-moments rather than broad philosophical statements.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received almost zero traction (21 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, bitter, or generalized shayari; focus on soft, realistic emotional resonance instead.

weak_patterns.evidence: One-off topics like sister dynamics or general self-motivation scored low (19 to 173 views).
weak_patterns.action: Limit experimental topics until core relationship themes establish a steady baseline.
